 Advertisement Erin Lowrey Louisiana 6th Congressional District election results
 Erin Lowrey The 6th Congressional District will likely head to a runoff on the Dec. 12 ballot. 
 Below are the results of the race:

TAMMANY SHERIFF | PLAQUEMINES PARISH PRESIDENT | BOGLAUSA MAYOR | ORLEANS PARISH | JEFFERSON PARISH | ST. TAMMANY PARISH | WASHINGTON PARISH | TANGIPAHOA PARISH | ST. JOHN PARISH | ST. JAMES PARISH | ST. BERNARD PARISH | PLAQUEMINES PARISH | ST. CHARLES PARISH | TERREBONNE PARISH | LAFOURCHE PARISH | 
 It is too soon to call who will make the runoff.
 The position was formerly held by U.S. Rep. Cleo Fields, who has since launched a campaign for Louisiana Senate District 14.
 The district was redrawn in the spring and is now a majority-white district.
 Those on the ballot include Republicans Monique Appeaning, Larry Davis III, "Rick" Edmonds, Michael Mebruer, Blake Miguez, and Stephen Wagley. Democrats on the ballot include Chauna Banks, Patrick "Pat" Forbes, and Lindsay "Rubia" Garcia.
 Rufus Craig is also on the ballot for the Libertarian Party.
 This election will more than likely result in a December runoff.
 The 6th Congressional District covers Baton Rouge, parts of the River Parishes, and stretches into Shreveport.
